name: Siphoning Spirit
disable: DC 48 Occultism check (expert) or DC 48 Religion check (expert) to weaken the spirit; four total successes are required to disable the haunt
reset: After 1 minute, the spirit is satiated, and the haunt deactivates as it returns to a resting state. Over the course of 1 hour, the spirit's siphoned life energy disperses and the haunt resets.
routine:
(1 action; death, divine, necromancy, void) The spirit inhales, siphoning the souls of the living and becoming more visible. Each creature within 60 feet takes 4d10+20 void damage, with a DC 41 Fortitude save save. If no creatures are within the area, the haunt moves up to 120 feet into the largest concentration of living creatures and then inhales.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and increases its Drained value by 1, to a maximum of drained 4.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and increases its drained value by 2, to a maximum of drained 4. If the creature was already drained 4, it dies.

items.name: Sudden Siphon
items.text:
Trigger A living creature passes within 15 feet of the spirit

---

Effect The invisible spirit latches onto the life essence of the living, dealing 4d10+20 void damage to all living creatures within 60 feet (DC 41 basic Fortitude save save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: A formless spirit drains life from the living, becoming progressively visible as its victims weaken.
